issue.title: Retire provider_usage_metrics
issue.description: Beta gate for subscription usage probes and the optional provider usage hook.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The usage-release phase deletes the Off branch, makes the On path unconditional, and keeps the durable llm_provider.usage_metrics.enabled preference.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Usage probes, isolated workers, and passive observation writes stay off; existing provider invoke paths and plugins that omit the new hooks are unchanged.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Subscription usage probes, the optional plugin usage hook, and usage_metrics configuration run so collectors can gather allowance windows.
